notes.title: Market/Food Update!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey, Junkers! 🛒🥤[/b][/p][p]It’s time for another big step forward! This week’s update introduces the brand-new [b]Market system[/b] along with the long-awaited [b]Stamina mechanics[/b]! 💪[/p][p]From now on, you can visit the shop, stock up on food and drinks, and discover which items keep you energized the longest. 🍔 Every purchase matters — choose wisely and manage your stamina to stay productive in the yard! ⚙️[/p][p]This is just the beginning of expanding survival-style elements in the game. We’ll keep improving and balancing the system based on your feedback, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts! 💬[/p][p]Of course, we’ve also fixed plenty of bugs you reported — thank you for helping us make the game better every week! 🛠️[/p][p]Check out the full patch notes for all the details. 📋[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Market & Food[/b][/h3][p]Here you can stock up on the food you need to restore stamina.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/68bc0868ae24ff251a13ca526ad6112ca77a4825.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check which products will significantly regenerate your hunger.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/a40accd791b30bee33c796e1aa351c788876b320.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can get a discount by paying the exact amount – the cashier doesn’t like counting change! 😄[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/1a7ffb9c370505dd98a58de2d9b2cc115746da77.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Hunger System [/b][/h3][p]Keep an eye on your character’s stamina — a junkman can’t collapse from hunger![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/5680c55d1e83397cdb5da526283f972991abdc75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ve got your portable fridge — make sure it’s always stocked and properly chilled! 😄[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/49814de1bf6f0d4d24b1e0c67e855ce75f949d8f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And if you happen to forget a meal, don’t worry! For a small fee (uhhh $1500!), the medical team will take care of you. Better avoid that expensive ride like the plague![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/c1b698528dd771fe37b2464cc1d82e2eb2e560f9.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/4580abde42f611ac45ee869116b50c60e7c76a83.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Video update[/b][/h3][p]🚀 [i]Market & Stamina Update – New Life for Your Junkyard![/i][/p][previewyoutube="3y8SoSyfcoo;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Junkyard Roadmap[/b][/h3][p][b]Yes, I know – you’ve asked me about this a million times[/b] 😅 and I always said I didn’t want to declare specific updates, since things on my end are pretty dynamic. [/p][p]Just remember – besides what you see on the plan, there will also be hotfixes and smaller updates that I didn’t include here. notes.title: 🚗Junkyard Boost – Unstuck car & Refuel Ready!🚗
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey, Junkers! 🚗⚡[/b][/p][p]Meet the new [b]Unstuck & Fuel Boost Update[/b]! Now you can zap yourself out of any stuck vehicle with a simple \[X] press — no more manual resets! Plus, refuel smarter and earn XP for every liter, whether from jerrycan or the gas station. Smooth rides and faster progress ahead! 🔧⛽✨[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hotfix list:[/b] [/p][p]🏗️ After enabling VSync, the FPS limit adjusts to the monitor's refresh rate – that’s why users with 120 Hz or 144 Hz monitors may notice a higher FPS cap than 60.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/13b49027bff06ca0710e2d43a560bb4e68827d24.png"][/img][/p][p]🏗️ We made a fix to the screen where you select the game mode – many players were accidentally choosing Sandbox Mode, which is intended for advanced players. Now it will be clearer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/ed7132f32c5e6fb5c9ba426a65e8b7471918f147.png"][/img][/p][p]🏗️ Added an Unstuck button in every vehicle. Now, if you get stuck somewhere while exploring the world, you no longer need to exit the vehicle and manually reset it with the \[R] key. Simply press \[X] while inside the vehicle, and it will teleport — with you inside — to the nearest allowed location.[/p][p][/p][p]🏗️ When resetting the tow truck near a vehicle ready to be loaded, its icon would not appear and the vehicle would not detect us until we drove away and entered its area again.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/15342804efb6918e405e24cc96877dfe4a417a61.png"][/img][/p][p]🏗️ Reworked how EXP is granted for refueling with a jerrycan — now you gain EXP for each liter added to the vehicle's tank, instead of only when refilling the jerrycan at a gas station.[/p][p][/p][p]🏗️ Added EXP gain for refueling vehicles directly at the gas station.[/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/953e239258c8ab8e168e4d2723e92de652707f05.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Massive junkyard hugs from your favorite rust whisperer —[/p][p][b]Junkman Adrian 😎💛[/b]🏗️[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Also please support us [/b][img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamthumbsup"][/img] 🙂[/p]

notes.title: Tow truck mechanics evolution and fuel station update!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey, Junkers! 🚨🚚[/b][/p][p]Time for another big step forward! This week’s update brings major improvements to [b]tow truck mechanics[/b] and introduces a fully working [b]fuel station[/b]! ⛽🔧[/p][p]We’ve fine-tuned how the tow truck handles, making it smoother, more realistic, and way more fun to use. Plus, the [b]fuel system[/b] is now live — giving you one more reason to keep your vehicles in shape and ready to roll! ⚙️[/p][p]As always, your feedback keeps us going! Drop us a review or let us know what you think — your ideas help shape the future of the game. The tow truck is now equipped with a lift, so you can transport two vehicles at once![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]You wanted to refuel your vehicles — so here it is: a gas station just for you![/b][/h3][p]You can now refuel your vehicles at the station.[/p][p](Psst... in future updates, you’ll be able to do some shopping there too — but more on that soon! :D)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/45d3e0e0c071a41c5773f03186afd6c8374b346e.png"][/img][/p][p]The fuel pump is ready for you — fill up as much as you like! :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/0af208b0bde08def0f2635aa0d8f754d27070c14.png"][/img][/p][p]Mini discount game — if you’re up for it, try hitting the center of the discount bar and rack up as much as you can. Thanks to your continued feedback and support, we’ve introduced a bunch of quality-of-life improvements and important fixes to streamline your junkyard operations! 🧰🚛

Hotfix list:
🛠️ Added the ability to close the confirmation message about enabling the loader using the ESC key on the keyboard and the corresponding button on the gamepad. This allows for emergency closure of the message and provides a more convenient option for players who prefer using ESC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/eb2aca46095b8167001384296ae6b19bcd616680.jpg[/img]
🛠️ A new feature has been introduced allowing players to close the message about vehicle wreck reset or processed scrap cube in the loader using the ESC key and the corresponding gamepad button. This enables emergency dismissal of the message and is more convenient for players who prefer using ESC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/06a4af3a41592f6fb371513917ca06d8391dce14.jpg[/img]
🛠️ It is now possible to close the message about the loader position reset using the ESC key and the corresponding gamepad button. This allows for emergency message closure and offers a more convenient option for ESC users.

🛠️ Interaction with the wreck unloading panel no longer requires directly looking at it. The unloading panel’s functionality has been changed to allow activation by simply approaching it, without the need to aim the camera directly at it. This change greatly improves the experience for players using lower-end PCs, where there were previously issues with interacting using the [E] key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/267f59199e4ed7dad00ee67e81b69d2764adcef8.jpg[/img]
🛠️ Bug fix for the “Fast Travel” quest – first wreck. Fixed an issue that prevented the use of the loader during the “Fast Travel” quest when the player was transporting the first wreck onto the tow track as part of the unloading panel task. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/2fba6359a438dbb15eb22fd85f0a154744610eaf.jpg[/img]
🛠️ Bug fix for the “Fast Travel” quest – second wreck. Resolved an issue where the loader could not be used when transporting the second wreck onto the tow track in the same quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/0fc5f5770c5f21ee303aec418084a6042936651c.jpg[/img]

Further game optimization increased the FPS from 4 up to 12, depending on the location in the game. We are constantly working on it. The game increased fluidity, and we got rid of many stutterings – which we will keep fixing until release.

We changed and optimized the shader system on objects. Now they are loading much faster and display textures in higher quality.

We fixed the issue with mouse sensitivity settings not being saved.

We are about 60% done with moving mechanics from the old engine to a new one. Work is going well, and you should expect another big update at the end of January. notes.title: Junkyard Devlog - World Map and Exploration
notes.notes:
[b]Hello![/b]

[b]We’re back with some new info about Junkyard Simulator. As you might know, we’re still testing and improving our game to give you the best possible experience. In the meantime, we would like to show you various gameplay elements. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/3985d6201f45ecd5c90273fc7d136926cb40f447.png[/img]


[b]Today, we would like to introduce you to the map and exploration of the world.[/b]


[h3][b]MAP[/b][/h3]

Junkyard Simulator is an experience based on instant searching for the most interesting scrap, parts of the machines and other various items to process, renovate or sale. If you want your business to grow you should be aware of your surroundings. That is why we want to enrich the gameplay by giving you a large map to explore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/fbba6509fa6bf04b6de16d38810218d2c8fca517.jpg[/img]

Large Map will give you detailed information about the game area. You’ll be able to get a better lay of the land and plan your routes efficiently. You should keep in mind that it offers a lot of interesting locations with loot to find. 


[h3][b]CART[/b] [/h3]

As you can find a lot of scrap in the surrounding areas, you will need something more than a backpack to transport it. The cart will be perfect at the beginning of your adventure - take it and load what you can. It will be a good setup for developing your business and earning some money to afford better vehicles.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/20519cd469f439e19b4ebe4c539bd31d5e0671d3.jpg[/img]


Unfortunately, it is hard to pick up girls with that… but Lucy will be very helpful in expanding your junky empire by giving you some quests ^^


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/773ed80789a3f7458b6fb2e8dbdf78e2c6b833a6.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]LOCATIONS[/b][/h3]

While exploring the open world of Junkyard simulator you will find various locations for scavenging. Check abandoned buildings in the forest, visit junkyards of your fellow NPC’s and unlock new skills or game mechanics by completing quests in different places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/1e4621508deacccd950c27ada0d8305eb7044cf6.jpg[/img]

If you don’t want to use the map all the time you can also pay attention to signs that will help in navigating the area.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/bec67d20f6c21c3af570e119cc2b6ef92b4c8ee4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Weekly GameDev update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/35154fae9534d2409441bcd6778257b347f40d18.jpg[/img]

We’re working on better game optimization and fixing small bugs. Here is a list from last week:

- We rebuild game scaling mechanisms and resolution settings.
- In Quest 3 we fixed a bug blocking the completing the task
- We’ve solved problems with display mode settings for non-native display resolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/3cdd401dcf887f76ab259d525811cc767450920e.jpg[/img]
 
- We’ve fixed a bug with bear and the quest.
- We’ve eliminated all the places indicated by testers where the gamer can get stuck somehow.
- We’ve completed the missing collisions spaces/walls in the junky house (the optimization script wasn’t fully read)
- Now all quests texts are fitted to the window.
- We improved item counting in the starter container and we added dust particles and sound of counting.
- We've fixed the order of messages displaying.
- We added extra space for the description in the tutorial menu. Before now it was displayed on the video what was hard to read. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/642b56398b93bd7d6d407b24d66f1c868d311026.jpg[/img]

- Grid alignment in the whole UI and main menu
- We solved the problem with keys and the gate after leaving the barrack (now the gate is openable).
- Dialog skipping is automatic (after a few seconds). It can be turned off in the game settings.
- The hand brake is pulled automatically after getting out of the car. So now there is no possibility of “jumping off the car” during the ride. 
- We have fixed a bug of blocking the player after jumping off from the overturned cart.
- In the main menu of the game, after playing the trailer we had a problem with sound on the intro. Now the problem is solved. 
- We have improved the graphic scale for ~75 items
- We cut the time of displaying tutorial on the screen.
- UI update for all vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/162e363bbcd2bdcc7f4f49566aba6d7158faf8fa.jpg[/img]

And much more which were hard to explain without knowledge about the gameplay and the storyline.

notes.title: Weekly GameDev update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/e12ffa7c4349537c3d53a6ceef2d08300c5412d6.jpg[/img]

1. After suggestions from QA, we’ve rebuild the UI of minimap and notebook. From now the map and notebook are available after pressing [TAB].
2. We swap action between [F] and [E].
3. We proceed to rebuild the level by connecting the viaduct with the main road and access road to the workshop.
4. On QA request we added new signposts to make navigating and moving on the level much easier.
5. We developed a Backpack for 12 items with graphic design and the pictures of the items. Now the gameplay is nicer. You can use a cart for 7-14 items with the backpack with 12 empty slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/047e94a2ca08122e0c26d5d3b778d6d2a7de27ba.jpg[/img]

6. The game is scaled up to 4K.
7. We’ve added a story to the game with a voice actor.
8. Bug fixing for tutorials and quests.
9. Now the cart garage is closer to the start point of the game.
10. We implemented such languages like: English 100%, Polish 100%, German: 50%, Spanish: 100%, Russian: 100%.
11. Optimizing graphics performance. We added an option for changing the quality of the graphics. From now you can change the range of pixel density and adjust the post-processing for the lower settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/06f83b8455f58c5f66749c6efac4ceb5e832bbb5.jpg[/img]

12. Savepoint system has been improved. You can save the game between sub-quests and anytime during the task. All items from the backpack and the nearest Junkman arena will be remembered for your next playing session. But at the same time, the game will be filled up with new random items whenever you’re restarting the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/ab9d1db6a9cd92b42366279eab0b066040aaefc4.jpg[/img]

13. The keyboard logic and steering are refined.
14. Minimap bug fixing.
15. As Robert suggested, from now you have a possibility of recalling the cart by pressing one button.
16. All the places where the player could be blocked somehow are fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/20e562724f1ba28642fd26866d0c4d0f2c975291.jpg[/img]

17. We redesigned the tutorial window by adding arrows and making the list more useful.
18. The gameplay has better guiding. In all key moments, you will hear Bob's voice, your main client.
19. We simplified the user interface after QA suggestions.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/2720d559dadfe01e1029ba403128bf6d9875c61e.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for your discussion. The matter is showing up in many companies and many titles and believe us, it’s also a subject we're discussing internal. We can’t say we have a golden reception and we’re far away from the position of saying how things should work. We are learning and gathering experience by doing things and listening the people. Your insights are very helpful and we're going to improve on many fields during the work on our games.
Secondly, blaming our publisher isn’t ok. We work together very close during the development and we are deciding on everything together. For example, we made a decision about expanding the game for additional mechanics together.

For sure we can do better many things around the game (like community support etc.) but still, we’re focusing 99% of our energy on the most important - finishing the game. 

Btw. We closed another week without any problems or speed bumps. We share more information in the coming update.

PS “The last straight” has his name for a reason :).
